panels.description: Difference between current block and last block update for validators

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), ck.identity_name, LEFT(h.hotkey, 8) || '...') AS validator, b.number - mm.last_update AS " ", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON n.hotkey_id = h.id
JOIN metagraph_coldkey ck ON ck.id = h.coldkey_id
JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id
  AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1)
  AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
JOIN metagraph_block b ON ns.block_id = b.number
LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND ns.is_validator = true
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY ns.total_stake DESC

targets.rawSql:

  mm.incentive AS " ",
  h.hotkey,
  b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)

WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND n.first_seen_block > (
    SELECT MIN(number) FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}'
  )
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}';

SELECT inn.incentive AS "deregistration zone", inn.time
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp AS time,
    mm.incentive AS incentive,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY mm.incentive ASC) AS rn
  FROM metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)

    JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}

    AND NOT ns.is_immune
    AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY b.timestamp, mm.incentive          -- dedupe to distinct incentive values
) AS inn

panels.description: This simulates how incentive would look like if it wasn't clipped to consensus

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	date_bin(GREATEST(INTERVAL '72 minutes', ('${__to:date}'::timestamptz - '${__from:date}'::timestamptz) / 200),
	  created_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS time,
	uid,
	AVG(weight) AS value
FROM (
	SELECT b.timestamp AS created_at, tgt.uid,
	       SUM((w.weight / NULLIF(src_mm.weights_sum, 0)) * src_ns.normalized_stake) AS weight
	FROM metagraph_weight w
	  JOIN metagraph_neuron src ON src.id = w.source_neuron_id
	  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot src_ns ON src_ns.neuron_id = w.source_neuron_id AND src_ns.block_id = w.block_id
	  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics src_mm ON src_mm.snapshot_id = src_ns.id AND src_mm.mech_id = w.mech_id
	  JOIN metagraph_neuron tgt ON tgt.id = w.target_neuron_id
	  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = w.block_id
	WHERE src.subnet_id = ${subnet}
	  AND tgt.subnet_id = ${subnet}
	  AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id}
	  AND w.weight > 0
	  AND w.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND w.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
	  AND src_mm.weights_sum != 0
	  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
	GROUP BY tgt.uid, b.timestamp
) t
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

	FROM metagraph_neuron n
	  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
	  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id

	WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}

	GROUP BY n.uid, b.timestamp, mm.consensus

GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT
  b.timestamp AS time,
  t.val,
  256 - COUNT(1) AS " "
FROM (
  SELECT
    w.block_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sh.label, ''), NULLIF(sck.label, ''), sck.identity_name, LEFT(sh.hotkey, 8) || '...') AS val,
    tgt.uid
  FROM metagraph_weight w
    JOIN metagraph_neuron src ON src.id = w.source_neuron_id
    JOIN metagraph_hotkey sh ON sh.id = src.hotkey_id
    JOIN metagraph_coldkey sck ON sck.id = sh.coldkey_id
    JOIN metagraph_neuron tgt ON tgt.id = w.target_neuron_id
  WHERE src.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND tgt.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id}
    AND w.weight != 0
    AND w.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND w.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  GROUP BY w.block_id, val, tgt.uid
) AS t
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = t.block_id
WHERE b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp, t.val
HAVING 256 - COUNT(1) >= 0;

WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block
             WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AS lo,
           (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block
             WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}'   ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS hi
  ),
  -- one row per neuron: its most recent mech-${mech_id} incentive in the last ~30m
  ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.id) n.id AS neuron_id, mm.incentive
    FROM metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT s.id, s.block_id
      FROM metagraph_neuron_snapshot s
      WHERE s.neuron_id = n.id
        AND s.block_id > (SELECT max(number) FROM metagraph_block) - 150
    ) ns ON TRUE
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT m.incentive
      FROM metagraph_mechanism_metrics m
      WHERE m.snapshot_id = ns.id AND m.mech_id = ${mech_id}
    ) mm ON TRUE
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    ORDER BY n.id, ns.block_id DESC
),
  top_miner AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT neuron_id FROM ranked
    ORDER BY incentive DESC, neuron_id          -- deterministic tiebreak
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0
  )
  SELECT wt.weight AS " ",
         b.timestamp AS time,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), ck.identity_name, LEFT(h.hotkey, 8) || '...') AS validator
  FROM metagraph_neuron src
  CROSS JOIN top_miner tm
  CROSS JOIN bounds bd
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT w.weight, w.block_id
    FROM metagraph_weight w
    WHERE w.source_neuron_id = src.id
      AND w.target_neuron_id = tm.neuron_id
      AND w.block_id BETWEEN bd.lo AND bd.hi
      AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id}
  ) wt ON TRUE

AS hotkey_label, h.hotkey AS hotkey, ns.total_stake / 1e9 AS total_stake_tao, ns.normalized_stake, ns.rank, ns.trust, mm.incentive, mm.dividend, mm.consensus, mm.validator_trust, ns.is_validator, ns.is_active, ns.is_immune FROM metagraph_neuron n JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON n.hotkey_id = h.id JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id} WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND ns.block_id = (SELECT MAX(number) FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}') ORDER BY ns.total_stake DESC

WITH latest_block AS (
  SELECT MAX(number) AS maxnum
  FROM metagraph_block
  WHERE timestamp < '${__to:date}'
),
window_snaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ns.neuron_id)
    ns.id AS snapshot_id, ns.neuron_id, ns.uid,
    ns.total_stake, ns.emissions, ns.is_validator, ns.is_immune, ns.neuron_version
  FROM metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns
    JOIN metagraph_neuron n ON n.id = ns.neuron_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_block lb
  WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND ns.block_id > lb.maxnum - 600            -- last 120m
  ORDER BY ns.neuron_id, ns.block_id DESC
),
stake_sums AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_stake) / 1e9 AS total_stake_sum
  FROM window_snaps
  WHERE is_validator = true
),
neuron_data AS (
  SELECT
    ck.coldkey, h.hotkey, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), ck.identity_name, '') AS hk_label, n.uid,
    ws.neuron_version,
    ws.emissions / 1e9 AS emissions,
    mm.dividend AS dividends,
    mm.incentive AS incentives,
    ws.total_stake / 1e9 AS total_stake,
    ws.is_immune, ws.is_validator
  FROM window_snaps ws
    JOIN metagraph_neuron n ON n.id = ws.neuron_id
    JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
    JOIN metagraph_coldkey ck ON ck.id = h.coldkey_id
    LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ws.snapshot_id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY emissions DESC) AS pos,
  emissions,
  dividends,
  incentives,
  hk_label AS alias,
  hotkey,
  coldkey,
  uid,
  total_stake AS stake,
  total_stake / NULLIF(stake_sums.total_stake_sum, 0) AS stake_normalized,
  1e15 * dividends / GREATEST(1, total_stake) / GREATEST(1, stake_sums.total_stake_sum) AS div2stake,
  is_validator,
  is_immune,
  neuron_version AS "neuron version"
FROM neuron_data, stake_sums
ORDER BY emissions DESC;

SELECT
	date_bin(GREATEST(INTERVAL '72 minutes', ('${__to:date}'::timestamptz - '${__from:date}'::timestamptz) / 200),
	  created_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS time,
	uid,
	AVG(rn) AS value
FROM (
	SELECT b.timestamp AS created_at, n.uid,
	  CASE
	    WHEN ns.emissions = 0 THEN 0
	    ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
	      PARTITION BY b.timestamp
	      ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC, n.first_seen_block ASC
	    )
	  END AS rn
	FROM metagraph_neuron n
	  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
	  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
	WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
	  AND (ns.is_immune OR ns.has_any_weights)          -- miner set
	  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
) t
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Miner UID order heatmap in sn${subnet} for consensus>0 uids

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), ck.identity_name, LEFT(h.hotkey, 8) || '...') AS validator,
  CASE
    WHEN ns.total_stake = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (mm.incentive + mm.dividend) * 7200 * 1000 / (ns.total_stake / 1e9)
  END AS " ",
  b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_coldkey ck ON ck.id = h.coldkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND ns.is_validator = true
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY ns.total_stake DESC;
